Maya K: Heads-up — trying to lock schedule for a combined Security + Privacy compliance sync next week. Propose Thu Mar 26 3:00pm PST (90m) or Wed Mar 25 10:00am PST (60m). Agenda draft: 1) Threat modeling for tokenization changes 2) Access recert plan 3) Audit readiness checklist (SOC/ISO) 4) Secrets rotation RFC review (5-10m) 5) Rollout timeline. Who can make Thu 3pm? @Samir @Julian @Ria Patel @Devon
Samir: Thu 3pm works for me, 90m ok. I'll own threat modeling notes.
Julian: Thu is best. Can we add a short discussion on log export and retention policy? that's related to audit evidence.
Ria Patel: Thu 3pm +1. I can prep the secrets-rotation RFC summary. I'll invite Legal.
Devon: Infra needs ~30m to cover rollout constraints (can we slot it after the threat model?). If 90m, fine.
Maya K: Cool — sounds like consensus. Updated agenda: (A) Threat model (Samir) 35m (B) Infra rollout (Devon) 25m (C) Access recert + Audit checklist (Ria) 20m (D) RFC quick review 10m. @Bea (Legal) please join for audit checklist.
Samir: I'll drop the threat model doc here: https://redwood.team/drive/threat-model-tokenization — plz skim before the meeting, comments inline.
Julian: Who's creating the calendar invite? Also, add the onboarding engineers alias so product owners can join.
Ria Patel: I'll create the invite and include Bea (Legal), @product-owners, and eng-sre. Will attach pre-reads: threat model link + secrets RFC PR #482.
calendar-bot: Event created — Security & Privacy Compliance Sync — Thu Mar 26 15:00 PST (90m). Guests: Maya K, Samir, Julian, Ria Patel, Devon, Bea (Legal), product-owners, eng-sre.
Maya K: Thanks Ria. Small ask — please add an action column in the agenda doc for owners and due dates.
sec-bot: Reminder set — Please add PR links and any concerns by EOD Tue Mar 24. Use thread: #security-compliance-prereads.
Ria Patel: Will do. I'll post the RFC PR link and a 2-slide summary by Monday.
Devon: Noted. I'll prepare a list of infra constraints (GPU scaling, migration windows) and tag the rollout playbook.
Samir: If anyone wants to run a quick pre-brief, ping me — I can do 15m Wed afternoon.
Maya K: Perfect — I'll send final agenda + invite tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
